name: akbun-contentcreator
description: Content creation skills for the faceless study channel 악분일상 — pick experiment-sized video topics, turn Obsidian study notes into problem→expectation→experiment→result scripts with 15-second hooks, and build the upload kit from a finished script: honest titles and thumbnail text, a Tistory post cross-linked with the video, and under-60-second Shorts

interface.shortDescription: Topics, scripts, and the upload kit (titles, Tistory post, Shorts) for the faceless study channel 악분일상
interface.longDescription: Helps produce the YouTube channel 악분일상, a faceless study channel whose strength is checking official documentation by direct experiment. Every skill keeps the problem → expectation → experiment → result structure, never invents numbers, and links each video with its Tistory post. akbun-contentcreator-topic-finder scans official docs, security news and the blog's popular posts for five video candidates that fit one problem and one experiment. akbun-contentcreator-script-builder turns an Obsidian study note into a script in that order and writes three 15-second hooks. akbun-contentcreator-publish-kit takes the finished script and makes any or all of: five titles and three thumbnail phrases filtered against the coaching document's title examples, a Tistory post with the video link at the top and a blog link line for the video description, and two or three Shorts scripts under 60 seconds cut from the result moments.
defaultPrompt: 공식 문서·보안 뉴스·내 블로그 인기 글을 훑어서 '문제 하나, 실험 하나'로 풀 수 있는 영상 후보 5개 뽑아줘 (akbun-contentcreator-topic-finder)
이 옵시디언 공부 노트를 문제→예상→실험→결과 순서의 영상 대본으로 바꾸고 첫 15초 훅 3개 만들어줘 (akbun-contentcreator-script-builder)
이 대본으로 제목 5개·썸네일 문구 3개, 티스토리 글, 60초 쇼츠 대본까지 업로드 준비물 한 번에 만들어줘 (akbun-contentcreator-publish-kit)
이 대본으로 티스토리 글만 써 주고 영상 링크와 블로그 링크를 서로 넣어줘 (akbun-contentcreator-publish-kit)
